draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.34, the 42nd-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 5th of 29 at CB. He lasted until pick 76, well after his grade rank (42nd): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Benjamin St-Juste. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 2 passes defended in 2024, 23rd of 29 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Dallas Cowboys. 7 career games and 5 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 1 AV in 2025. Weak spots: passer rating allowed 126.1 (4th percentile), completion % allowed 73.7% (8th percentile). Played 7 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-1 cornerback who played: 30.2% season snap share against a median of 27.6%, above the norm.
